rejected_captures_2026_08_25.reason: The alternative.me source attribution fix DID take, but the frame's AI Summary renders 'Crowd positioning is stretching; tighten stops and take partial profits into strength.' — imperative investment advice in legible pixels on a finance app. Also status-bar/content collision. This is a product-level string, not just a screenshot problem.
Status bar drawn directly over scrolled content (no scrim behind it on the home scroll view); 02 also shows 'Source · CryptoSage AI' self-attribution and a 3:04 AM wall-clock leak.

Paper-trading panel is locked behind Pro. SubscriptionManager.loadState() forces currentTier = .free and rewrites UserDefaults, so the harness -Subscription.CurrentTier argument is overwritten on every launch. Shooting this needs a StoreKit test configuration or a sandbox purchase.

Valid build-14 compliance proof of the SampleCommunityNotice, but NOT marketing frames: the site deliberately removed every social/leaderboard claim on 2026-08-24 because the whole social layer is local-only. Wiring these back would re-open a closed claim. disc_leaderboard also asserts its disclosure over an empty list.
